 Role Summary:
 This is a hands-on production-focused role where you’ll primarily work with ready-made templates. Instead of designing from scratch, your main task will be to adapt and customize existing materials — ensuring consistency, creativity, and quick turnaround. If you thrive on detail, efficiency, and bringing visuals to life, this role is for you.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Adapt ready-made templates to create new variations of visuals and videos.

• Modify texts, colors, images, and small design details as required.

• Ensure consistent visual quality while delivering multiple versions of assets.

• Render 8–10 second video clips from provided templates using a powerful workstation.

• Collaborate remotely, following business hours in the Estonian time zone.

• Deliver polished, final visuals/videos on schedule.

 Your Skills and Competences:

• Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop).

• Experience with Blender for 3D work and rendering.

• After Effects skills are a strong plus.

• Keen attention to detail and ability to work quickly without sacrificing quality.

• Access to a high-performance computer capable of rendering short animations.

• Comfortable working in sync with Estonian business hours- 8 hours of work per day (commencing at 10:00 AM)

• Good English communication skills for collaboration and feedback.

 We Offer:
 • Amicable work environment and supportive team members
 • Opportunities for professional development and career growth
 • Innovative and experienced global team
 Hiring Stages:

• Introductory call

• Technical assignment

• Hiring Manager round
